title: Seoul says Hangang Bus has not hurt private cruise passenger numbers
caption:
Concerns that Seoul's new public river bus would hurt private cruise businesses were unfounded. Data shows both services are seeing higher ridership this year.

Source: Koreaherald - Seoul says Hangang Bus has not hurt private cruise passenger numbers
